Quartez 21.name: Quartez 21
Quartez 21.description: Textured paint with quartz for a rough, durable, stone-like exterior finish.
Quartez 21.more_detail:
Quartez 21 is a type of textured paint that contains quartz particles, giving it a rough, Medium, Fine and durable finish. It’s commonly used for exterior walls due to its resistance to weather conditions and its ability to provide a decorative, stone-like appearance

Coverage: [7 to 9 square m /25kg ]
Finish: GLOSS
Drying Time: ≈ [6 to 10] hours.
Application: using plastic or steel trowel
